manual_compatibility_workflow.scope: All fork Go tests with race detection, full vet, same-fork CLI build and classic Shadowsocks client/server TCP/UDP self-wire

original_behavior_policy.vmess_socks_ambiguous_legacy_selection: Node URI metadata automatically generates matching internal fields; original Xray JSON ignored fields and AUTO fallbacks stay unchanged
original_behavior_policy.shadowsocks_server_first: Automatic on node URI input; original full JSON retains its prior default and low-level setting
original_behavior_policy.http_settings: Parsed and built only for an explicitly selected standalone HTTP2 transport
original_behavior_policy.owner_stability_fixes: Preserved; no broad reset to upstream

verified_custom_additions: Automatic common node-URI input: paths selected from node metadata without per-feature switches; original JSON semantics retained
Shadowsocks AES-192-GCM: explicit client/server/multi-user configuration, TCP and UDP
Shadowsocks AES-128/192/256-CFB, CTR and OFB: explicit single-user client/server, TCP and UDP
Shadowsocks AEAD server-first: optional serverFirstCompatibility for original methods; no hidden default change
Shadowsocks bf-cfb, cast5-cfb, des-cfb, rc4, rc4-md5, salsa20, chacha20, chacha20-ietf, table, none/plain: explicit single-user TCP/UDP
Original ChaCha20 64-bit counter carry, Salsa20 counter exhaustion, per-account immutable table permutations
Shadowsocks camellia-128/192/256-cfb, idea-cfb, rc2-cfb (128 effective bits), seed-cfb (SEED-128): explicit single-user TCP/UDP
SOCKS4 and SOCKS4a outbound TCP CONNECT: new protocol selectors or legacySettings.version, user ID, local IPv4 versus remote domain resolution; original SOCKS5 semantics retained
VMess legacySettings.security for aes-128-cfb/none framed bodies and TCP-only zero; inbound weak bodies require legacySettings.allowLegacyBody
VMess legacySettings.alterId1..64 timestamp/HMAC headers and MD5 response keys; ignored top-level alterId stays modern; bounded legacy index and replay cache
Standalone legacy HTTP2 TCP carrier: http/h2/http2 selectors with TLS, explicit prior-knowledge h2c; independent transport and historical httpSettings schema; REALITY pairing pending and rejected
application_sdk_acceptance: Common Go URI entry point implemented; complete native application ABI/mobile integration not implemented or validated
ss2022_selftest_scope: SS2022 package tests exist; classic self-wire fixture does not include SS2022
